name: Entremets
description:
A class about constructing unique entremets with various components and textures. Learn how to create, assemble, and balance ratios of components, while glazing, garnishing and finishing your entremets to look exquisite.
• Coffee & Hazelnut Entremet (Coffee & Hazelnut Moelleux, Coffee Cremeux, Hazelnut Praline Crunch, Milk Chocolate Coffee Mousse

• Tropical Entremet (Banana Sponge, Exotic Fruit Compote, Passion Cremeux, Caramelised White Chocolate Mousse, Mirror Glaze)

name: Eggless baking
description:
This workshop is specially designed to equip you with the understanding of eggless baking! Apart from learning recipes, you will be taught the concepts of finding suitable eggless substitutes!
- Peanut Butter Cookie
- Lime & Coconut Tart
- Dark Chocolate Cupcake
- Blondie
- Chocolate Jaggery & Whole Wheat Loaf

name: Basics in Chocolate
description:
Who doesn’t love a piece of chocolate? Learn the science & techniques of tempering couverture chocolate to attain the shiniest of bonbons, decadent truffles & delicious ganache fillings.
• Truffles (3 types)
• Bonbons (4 types)

name: Basics in bread
description:
Learn how to make easy but delicious breads & understand the basic fundamentals of bread making, from selecting the right flour to proofing and baking of bread. This workshop is perfect for someone with very little or no experience in baking. These varieties of breads are great options for your day-to-day baking.
- Soft rolls
- Ladi Pav
- Sandwich Loaf
- Burger Bun
- Grissini

name: Puff Pastry & Choux
description:
A session of classical french pastries – a showcasing of hand lamination, achieving a flakey, buttery puff pastry with sweet & savoury fillings. Pair that with the beauty of making, piping & baking choux buns & eclairs alongside flavours of creme patissiere.
Puff Pastry:
- Savoury puff
- Apple turnovers
Choux Pastry:
- Chocolate Profiteroles with chocolate pastry cream and Chocolate Namelaka
- Mango Eclair with mango pastry cream with Vanilla Namelaka

name: 2-day Christmas Baking
description:
Learn techniques and recipes for classic festive products in this fun filled two-day workshop, covering a wide range of Christmas goodies.
• Christmas Plum Cake
• Dundee Cake
• Plum Pudding
• Dresden Stollen
• Kugelhopf
• Florentine Bars
• Mince Pies
• Crinkle Cookie
• Kipferl Cookie
• Spiced Chocolate Truffles
• Yule Log
• Gingerbread Man
• Christmas Verrine
• Chocolate Mediants
• Inclusion Bars
